_capture.method: NOT CAPTURED. Fixture-only: api.gbif.org, rs.gbif.org and techdocs.gbif.org are denied by the capture sandbox's egress policy (CONNECT 403, 2026-09-26), so no live descriptions body could be recorded.
_capture.note: GBIF species/{usageKey}/descriptions paged response shape (offset, limit, endOfRecords, results[] with key, taxonKey, type, language, description, source, sourceTaxonKey, creator, contributor, license) as documented at https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/openapi/v1/species. Every description text, citation and dataset key is deliberately fictional ('FIXTURE-') and is not taxonomic content. Used to pin that a taxon whose only GBIF description is locality-bearing yields no morphology source and an explicit absence statement.
